number_of_elements: The number of unique chemical elements composing the superconducting material.
mean_atomic_mass: The average atomic mass of the elements in the superconductor.
wtd_mean_atomic_mass: The weighted average atomic mass of the elements, considering their atomic ratio.
gmean_atomic_mass: The geometric mean of the atomic mass of the elements in the superconductor.
wtd_gmean_atomic_mass: The weighted geometric mean of the atomic mass of the elements.
entropy_atomic_mass: The entropy (a measure of variance) of the atomic mass of the elements.
wtd_entropy_atomic_mass: The weighted entropy of the atomic mass of the elements.
range_atomic_mass: The range (difference between maximum and minimum value) of the atomic mass of the elements.
wtd_range_atomic_mass: The weighted range of the atomic mass of the elements.
std_atomic_mass: The standard deviation of the atomic mass of the elements.
wtd_std_atomic_mass: The weighted standard deviation of the atomic mass of the elements.
mean_fie: The average value of the first ionization energy of the elements.
wtd_mean_fie: The weighted average of the first ionization energy of the elements.
gmean_fie: The geometric mean of the first ionization energy of the elements.
wtd_gmean_fie: The weighted geometric mean of the first ionization energy of the elements.
entropy_fie: The entropy (a measure of variance) of the first ionization energy of the elements.
wtd_entropy_fie: The weighted entropy of the first ionization energy of the elements.
range_fie: The range of the first ionization energy of the elements.
wtd_range_fie: The weighted range of the first ionization energy of the elements.
std_fie: The standard deviation of the first ionization energy of the elements.
wtd_std_fie: The weighted standard deviation of the first ionization energy of the elements.
mean_atomic_radius: The average atomic radius of the elements.
wtd_mean_atomic_radius: The weighted average of the atomic radius of the elements.
gmean_atomic_radius: The geometric mean of the atomic radius of the elements.
wtd_gmean_atomic_radius: The weighted geometric mean of the atomic radius of the elements.
entropy_atomic_radius: The entropy (a measure of variance) of the atomic radius of the elements.
wtd_entropy_atomic_radius: The weighted entropy of the atomic radius of the elements.
range_atomic_radius: The range of the atomic radius of the elements.
wtd_range_atomic_radius: The weighted range of the atomic radius of the elements.
std_atomic_radius: The standard deviation of the atomic radius of the elements.
wtd_std_atomic_radius: The weighted standard deviation of the atomic radius of the elements.
mean_density: The average density of the elements.
wtd_mean_density: The weighted average of the density of the elements.
gmean_density: The geometric mean of the density of the elements.
wtd_gmean_density: The weighted geometric mean of the density of the elements.
entropy_density: The entropy (a measure of variance) of the density of the elements.
wtd_entropy_density: The weighted entropy of the density of the elements.
range_density: The range of the density of the elements.
wtd_range_density: The weighted range of the density of the elements.
std_density: The standard deviation of the density of the elements.
wtd_std_density: The weighted standard deviation of the density of the elements.
mean_electron_affinity: The average electron affinity of the elements.
wtd_mean_electron_affinity: The weighted average of the electron affinity of the elements.
gmean_electron_affinity: The geometric mean of the electron affinity of the elements.
wtd_gmean_electron_affinity: The weighted geometric mean of the electron affinity of the elements.
entropy_electron_affinity: The entropy (a measure of variance) of the electron affinity of the elements.
wtd_entropy_electron_affinity: The weighted entropy of the electron affinity of the elements.
range_electron_affinity: The range of the electron affinity of the elements.
wtd_range_electron_affinity: The weighted range of the electron affinity of the elements.
std_electron_affinity: The standard deviation of the electron affinity of the elements.
wtd_std_electron_affinity: The weighted standard deviation of the electron affinity of the elements.
mean_fusion_heat: The average heat of fusion of the elements.
wtd_mean_fusion_heat: The weighted average of the heat of fusion of the elements.
gmean_fusion_heat: The geometric mean of the heat of fusion of the elements.
wtd_gmean_fusion_heat: The weighted geometric mean of the heat of fusion of the elements.
